title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The headline indicates that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with fake case citations attributed to AI use. This fits a known failure mode in which a generative AI system produces plausible-sounding but nonexistent legal citations, and a user submits those citations in legal proceedings without independently verifying them. The failure occurs at the point of human use rather than inside the AI system itself, because the practitioner is responsible for checking sources before filing.

The article body was not available, so the specific AI tool involved, the court or courts affected, the nature of the suspension, and any procedural findings are not established from the available reporting.
